name: prune domains until every arc is consistent
mechanism: keep a queue of constraint arcs; for each, remove from one variable's domain every value that has no supporting value in the other variable's domain, and re-queue the arcs of any variable whose domain shrank, until no domain changes

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'AC-3 algorithm general algorithms for the constraint satisfaction' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms:

fails_when: arc consistency is not a solution; empty domains detect failure only
